items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Pig Meat Markham was there doing his thing... That was my first -- from then on we -- I must have played the Apollo

ctx.x: Oh, he used to get these soft mallets and he'd start banging away on these pieces of the xylophone, and they'd fly off into space and, you know, it was -- he had done this act in vaudeville. So he had a little act there that he did, and the band went over real good. Ralph Cooper was the master of ceremonies. Pig Meat Markham was there doing his thing, and [Puerto Rico] on the amateur night, you know, shooting the gun off and coming out in the grass. skirt and grabbing to grab all the people that didn't make it.…
circuit of theaters that no other white band had.
